message.content:
These are insulated electric conductors fitted with connectors, for a voltage of not more than 1,000 V. That points to heading 8544, and the connectors at each end make subheading 8544.42 the fit. Within it, 8544.42.90 covers other conductors fitted with connectors, and the 8544.42.20 line covers telecommunication-type cables. I recall CBP ruling NY N-series rulings classifying headset cables in 8544.42.9090, so I am going with that. 8544.42.90 is the "Other" line for conductors of not more than 1,000 V fitted with connectors, and its statistical suffix 90 is "Other".

{"hts_code": "8544.42.9090", "reason": "The cables are insulated electric conductors for not more than 1,000 V fitted with connectors at the ends, so they fall under heading 8544, subheading 8544.42, in the residual 'other' line."}
